en.content: The pH of ammonium phosphate solution, if pk<sub>a</sub> of phosphoric acid and pk<sub>b</sub> of ammonium hydroxide are 5.23 and 4.75 respectively, is ___________.
en.explanation:
Since (NH4)3PO4 is salt of weak acid (H3PO4) & weak base (NH4OH).

pH = 7 + (pka pkb)

= 7 + (5.23 4.75)

= 7.24 7.

hi.content: यदि फॉस्फोरिक एसिड का pk<sub>a</sub> और अमोनियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड का pk<sub>b</sub> क्रमशः 5.23 और 4.75 है, तो अमोनियम फॉस्फेट समाधान का pH ___________ है।

en.content: The number of stereoisomers possible for [Co(ox)<sub>2</sub>(Br)(NH<sub>3</sub>)]<sup>2<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.186ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.76ex" height="1.505ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -583 778 665" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="2212" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2212"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container></sup> is ___________. [ox = oxalate]
en.explanation:
The coordination compound [Co(ox)2(Br)(NH3)]2 of general formula [M(A - A)2BC] can show both geometrical and optical isomerism (stereoisomerism).

The cis-form produces non-superimposable mirror images, i.e. enantiomeric pairs (optically active)

The trans-form is optically inactive.

So, total number of stereoisomers possible = cis( ) + trans = 3

en.content:
A ball weighing 10 g is moving with a velocity of 90 ms1. If the uncertainty in its velocity is 5%, then the uncertainty in its position is ___________ 1033 m. (Rounded off to the nearest integer)

[Given : h = 6.63 1034 Js]
en.explanation:
m = 10 g = 102 Kg

v = 90 m/sec.

= v 5% = 90 = 4.5 m/sec

m . v . x

102 4.5 x

x

x 1.17 1033 = x 1033

x = 1.17 1

hi.content:
10 g वजनी गेंद 90 ms1 की वेग से चल रही है। इसके वेग में 5% की अनिश्चितता है, तो इसकी स्थिति में अनिश्चितता ___________ 1033 m है। (निकटतम पूर्णांक तक गोल किया गया)

[दिया गया: h = 6.63 1034 Js]
